definitions.current: Existing NP scorer weights, team goal means, common historical assist probability and physical MM kernel
definitions.individual: Player NP rates and individually shrunk xA set attack budgets; coherent team scores are their sums plus separate penalty process
definitions.blend50: Equal mixture of team-normalized and individual expected ordinary-goal/assist masses, no weight tuning
definitions.smoothed_assist: Current architecture; assist probability shrunk with 50 prior-goal observations from earlier seasons

MM: Identical analytical physical kernel in every arm; sampled means can fluctuate
cohort: Both seasons GW22-38, previously used research cohort; not independent validation
selection: Fixed four-arm diagnostic; no player-specific tuning or live promotion
metrics: xP RMSE primary, MAE guardrail; bias, goals/assists Poisson NLL+MAE and bonus MAE; fixture-cluster paired bootstrap
known_limits: Normal timeline has no red-card removals or concussion process
Individual xA is not the same target as FPL assists
Assist probability capped at 1 to preserve one assist per ordinary goal
Team goal changes affect clean sheets and bonus jointly
No TS activation or backtested transfer policy benefit claimed
